window-1.title: Cameron's World
window-1.blurb: An endless scroll of salvaged GeoCities GIFs and glitter dividers that feels like digging through a stranger's 1998 scrapbook — your DIY-typography, old-web heart is going to lose it.

window-2.title: Soon You Will Die: A History of the Culinary Selfie — Vittles
window-2.blurb: It's a whole cultural history of why we point cameras at our dinner — flash, grain, vanity, memory and all — and I think it'll hand you a shoot concept before you finish it.

window-4.title: Home for the Holidays with Apartamento
window-4.blurb: Apartamento never styles a room so much as lets it accumulate, and this is a whole edit of odd lamps, lumpy ceramics and good books to build a space out of — which is basically your decorating philosophy already, just with better taste in clutter.

window-5.title: Three Bowls: Sabah Style Pork Chop Kolo Mee
window-5.blurb: Dr Leslie just found a hawker doing Sabah-style kolo mee with a crispy pork chop on top — a noodle you can't get anywhere else here, which makes it exactly the kind of one-stall pilgrimage you'd turn into a whole Saturday.
